policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.

permit.value: Yes: zoning approval, then a city business licence, for stays of 179 days or less.

zones.value: Treated as motels. Allowed by right in Residence 2-B, C-3, C-4, C-5, light/heavy industry, airport industrial park and research park commercial; by special exception in C-2, C-6, research park application districts, RP-2 and airport commercial. Most residential zones bar them.

max_occupancy.value: No STR-specific guest cap: STRs need only a business license after zoning approval. Occupancy follows the Minimum Housing Standards floor-area rules (150 sq ft + 100 per extra person; 70/50 sq ft per sleeper).

taxes.value: City lodging tax 9% plus $2 per room-night, filed via Alabama ONE SPOT; state lodging tax 5% in Madison County (Ala. Code 40-26-1). Stays of 180+ days exempt.

listing_id.value: No listing-ID or permit-number display rule found: the city requires a business license and lodging-tax filing but its STR page and Ch. 15 business licence article set no platform-listing requirement.

pending.value: None found: the STR page shows no pending changes; recent uncodified ordinances (26-xxx) listed on Municode were not reviewed.

state_preemption.value: No STR preemption found; cities regulate via zoning and business licences. State lodging tax (Ala. Code 40-26-1) covers stays under 180 days: 5% in Madison and other mountain-lakes counties, 4% elsewhere. Platform collection not confirmed.
